title: Captain Viriato's radar track at Mach 15

tellings.quote: And uh Captain Virat recorded this thing on radar and it was he recorded at Mach 15 doing a zigzag pattern.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a 1986 incident in Brazil. He says that a Captain Viriato recorded an object on radar moving at Mach 15, meaning fifteen times the speed of sound, while flying in a zigzag pattern. If true, that is far beyond what any known aircraft can do.
